name: che-resources
description: Warn before the workspace runs out of room: disk space and inodes of the git projects' volume, memory, CPU and processes against the pod's limits, each with its own threshold.

cheResources.disk.threshold.markdownDescription: Warn when a disk holding a git project is used at or above this percentage of its size (`95` = under 5 % free). `0` turns this warning off.

cheResources.inodes.threshold.markdownDescription: Warn when a disk holding a git project has used this percentage of its inodes — `node_modules` can run out of them before it runs out of space. `0` turns this warning off.

cheResources.memory.threshold.markdownDescription: Warn when the container's working set reaches this percentage of its memory limit (`memory.max`), or of the host's memory without one. `0` turns this warning off.

cheResources.cpu.threshold.markdownDescription: Warn when the container's CPU, averaged over one check interval, reaches this percentage of its CPU limit (`cpu.max`), or of every CPU without one. Off by default: a build is meant to use the CPU. `0` turns this warning off.

cheResources.pids.threshold.markdownDescription: Warn when the container's processes reach this percentage of its process limit (`pids.max`). Nothing is read without a limit. `0` turns this warning off.

cheResources.intervalSeconds.markdownDescription: How often the resources are read, in seconds; the CPU is averaged over it.
